email_body:
Dear LIZY Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Content & Brand Manager position at LIZY, as advertised. Your mission to revolutionize car leasing with fresh energy and a digital-first approach deeply resonates with my professional background and aspirations.

With a unique blend of creative content development, robust SEO expertise, and hands-on web management, I am adept at crafting engaging online identities. My experience in leveraging AI for content creation and optimization, coupled with a technical understanding of web architecture, aligns perfectly with your need for a creative spark within a data-driven environment. I am fluent in English and possess working knowledge of Dutch, which I believe would be valuable for LIZY’s multi-market operations.

I am eager to contribute to LIZY’s growth and help define a distinct brand voice that truly stands out. Thank you for your time and consideration. I have attached my CV for your review and look forward to hearing from you.

cover_letter:
Dear LIZY Hiring Team,

I am writing with genuine enthusiasm to apply for the Content & Brand Manager position at LIZY. Your commitment to disrupting the traditional car leasing industry with a transparent, flexible, and digital-first approach is truly inspiring. I am particularly drawn to your call for a manager who can infuse a strong personality and identity into communication, a challenge that aligns perfectly with my professional experience and creative drive.

My background as a digital marketer with a technical foundation has equipped me with a hands-on ability to build and optimize online presences from conception to ongoing management. I have designed and managed websites, including baverok.com and client projects, developing comprehensive content strategies that elevate brand visibility and user engagement. From crafting SEO-driven blog posts to ensuring consistent visual and messaging across platforms and maintaining large-scale online communities, I am confident in my capacity to develop and execute game-changing content projects that resonate with LIZY’s audience.

I thrive on bringing a creative spark to data-driven environments, utilizing my proficiency in AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT for efficient research, content generation, and audits, while understanding the essential role of human ingenuity. My technical SEO skills, including structured data implementation and AI search visibility optimization, ensure that creative content also performs measurably. The ownership I’ve taken in freelance and client work, coupled with my fluent English and working knowledge of Dutch, prepares me to contribute effectively to LIZY's ambitious growth across diverse markets.

LIZY's values, particularly 'Wow' and 'Drive', reflect my own commitment to delivering exceptional results and continuous personal growth. I am eager to leverage my blend of content creation, brand consistency, and technical acumen to help LIZY become the European leader in digital car leasing. Thank you for considering my application; I am excited about the prospect of contributing to your innovative team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
- Combining almost three years of dedicated experience in content creation, SEO, and web management, driving measurable organic growth for client websites.
- Proven hands-on capabilities in SEO blog & content writing, website design & management (WordPress, Elementor, Canva), and crafting engaging online experiences.
- Daily proficiency in LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT) for research, content, and audits, coupled with strong technical SEO, AI search visibility, and Python automation skills.
- Experience in establishing consistent online identity, including designing and building websites from structure to content and maintaining layouts for large member communities.
- Fluent in English and proficient in Dutch (B1/A2+), providing a valuable asset for multi-market content strategy and localisation efforts.
